title: Show the Working normalisation output — one party's policies at a consistent grain + strict tagging

stated.description: fairly represents the consolidated policy, with merged mechanisms folded in

candidate_outcomes.description: strictly only the fundamentals the policy genuinely bears on; usually 1, rarely >2
